family.tagline: Field sketches on the deck, a Core in the study.
family.story: Camila illustrates wildlife and Soren writes software, both from their lake house in Alderkirk Bay. Alba is two, and her parents are making room for a second child. Years of sketchbooks and bird recordings live on one Companion Core.

companion.name: Orrin
companion.job: Opens Super Productivity in its own browser and sorts the day's task list.
companion.limits: Sorts a list. Soren decides what gets done.

companion.name: Nell
companion.job: Drafts print listings and notes to galleries from sketches Camila describes.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Camila sends every message.

chapters.title: The study, at the far end

popup.title: The long way to the study
popup.body: The parcel arrives at the front door. Soren carries it down the lake passage and the lake hall, all the way to the study.

popup.title: Camila unpacks the parcel
popup.body: Camila slits the tape. Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The footprint is about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Plug it in beside the easel
popup.body: Soren plugs in the cable by Camila's easel and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it while Alba sleeps
popup.body: With Alba asleep, Camila joins the Core's own network from her phone. Then she picks the home network.

popup.title: Pick your first agents and apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Soren picks OpenClaw and Camila picks Hermes. They add Immich, Jellyfin and Memos, plus Companion Memory (beta) for her sketchbooks. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: OpenClaw is an agent with its own browser and coding tools, running in its own sandbox, with iOS

popup.title: Orrin has a dry reply
popup.body: Soren sends the first message to Orrin, the agent he named. Orrin answers, and the Core is running.

say.speaker: soren
say.text: Hello, Soren. Orrin here. Which list first?

beats.capability: Stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Friday film, played from the Core
popup.body: Alba is asleep. Soren and Camila play a nature film from their own files. Jellyfin streams it from the Core to the TV.

beats.capability: Back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: A library with room for spring
popup.body: On the couch, Camila searches Alba's photos by date in Immich. A second baby is due in spring, and the library is ready.

beats.capability: A shared household hub for notes, shopping, chores and expenses, with a recipe book and an expiry

popup.title: Cook once, label the freezer
popup.body: Soren and Camila cook ahead at the breakfast bar. HomeHub's expiry tracker lists what is in the freezer and when each dish should be eaten.

beats.capability: Capture quick notes and journal entries in Markdown

popup.title: The morning's sightings, noted
popup.body: Camila jots the morning's bird sightings into Memos at the breakfast bar. The quick Markdown notes pile up into a field journal.

beats.capability: Plan your day, track time and run a Pomodoro timer

popup.title: Orrin sorts the day
popup.body: Soren tells Orrin the day's tasks. Orrin opens Super Productivity in its own browser and sorts the list. Soren decides what gets done.

say.speaker: soren
say.text: List sorted. Please check the order.

beats.capability: Draw logos, diagrams and line art as vector graphics, in your browser

popup.title: A heron becomes line art
popup.body: A heron stands in Camila's field sketch. She turns the pencil lines into clean vector art in Inkscape, ready for a print.

beats.capability: Hermes runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Nell drafts the gallery note
popup.body: Camila describes the heron print to Nell. Nell drafts the gallery note from the sketch notes Camila connected. Camila reads it and sends it herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: camila
say.text: Here is a draft. Please read it before you send it.

beats.capability: Turn a database into a spreadsheet-style app without writing code

popup.title: Every print, counted
popup.body: Camila tracks her prints in NocoDB: each size, each edition and how many are left. The table lives on the Core beside her easel.

popup.title: A consignment form, searchable
popup.body: A gallery's consignment agreement comes in as a scan. Paperless-ngx reads every page and tags it, so a search finds the terms later.

beats.capability: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: Six sketches, one portfolio
popup.body: For a gallery pitch, Camila merges six sketches into one portfolio PDF with Stirling-PDF. The merge runs on the Core.

beats.capability: Watch your sites and services and get an alert when one goes down

popup.title: A status page, all clear
popup.body: Soren keeps a status page on the Core. Uptime Kuma sends him an alert when one of the family's apps stops answering.

beats.capability: Search the web without being tracked or profiled

popup.title: Searching without a search account
popup.body: Soren runs his searches through SearXNG on the Core. It asks other search engines for him and returns one list of results.

beats.capability: Stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Owls sing Alba to sleep
popup.body: At bedtime Alba drifts off to a folder of Camila's owl recordings. Navidrome plays them beside the lullabies.

beats.capability: Lightweight checklists and notes with Kanban boards and sharing

popup.title: One checklist for the corner
popup.body: Soren and Camila keep one checklist in Jotty: paint the shelf, wash the small clothes, move the rocking horse.

beats.capability: Edit audio in a browser tab

popup.title: A wren, trimmed and faded
popup.body: At dawn Camila records a wren from the deck. She trims and fades the clip in AudioMass, and it joins her field recordings on the Core.

beats.capability: Read ebooks in your browser, with notes, highlights and text-to-speech

popup.title: A field guide, highlighted
popup.body: In a rocking chair, Camila reads a bird field guide in Koodo Reader. Her notes and highlights stay beside the page.

beats.capability: Plan, map and share hiking and biking routes from GPX files

popup.title: Saturday's shoreline walk, mapped
popup.body: Soren plots Saturday's shoreline walk in Wanderer from a GPX file. The saved route lives on the Core.

popup.title: A quiet house on the water
popup.body: A studio at the far end, a toddler who likes owls and a lake outside. The Ibarra-Holm household runs it all from one Companion Core.

closing.body: Your sketchbooks, recordings and family photos can live on a Companion Core at home. Start with one field sketch in Inkscape.

notes: Owner sign-off open: the FTUE hotspot flow is written as the owner specified and is not on the fact sheet (STORY-BIBLE section 15, item 1).

The second baby is mentioned once, in the family story and in living-photos, as a family fact ("due in spring"). No health, pregnancy or safety claim. Cut living-photos second sentence if the owner prefers.
ftue-delivery tells the long walk (cast awkwardScore 4). The text names the lake passage and lake hall, which are real room names in the house.
Cast job for Orrin and Nell kept. Nell (Hermes) only drafts a note to a gallery; Camila sends it. The Hermes note is on study-listing, the first Hermes beat, because Orrin (OpenClaw) greets first.
No OpenClaw beat opens a website: Orrin works only inside Super Productivity on the Core, so the OpenClaw web note is not used.
SearXNG (study-search) asks outside search engines over the home internet (catalog caveat). The text says it asks other search engines and does not call the search offline or fully private.
Jellyfin plays the family's own files only (catalog claim). Uptime Kuma replaces nothing in the chips; the catalog lists monitoring tools that do not belong in a family story.
Camila's print business is invented (casting name Ibarra Field Studies is not printed). Town Alderkirk Bay and street Cormorant Drive are invented and need the human map check.
